canonicalExplanation.text:
雾汀容量上限 240MB；部署：简单；维护：未声明。
杉海容量上限 900MB；部署：未声明；维护：复杂。
来源当前需求 180MB：仅容量满足的方案为雾汀、杉海；容量不足的方案为无。
来源仅说以后可能到 600MB，不是已确认的当前需求或未来计划。若显式按 600MB 作本地需求假设：仅容量满足的方案为杉海；容量不足的方案为雾汀。
容量上限是可提供量，需求是所需量；同单位按上限 ≥ 需求计算。部署简单不证明维护简单，维护复杂不证明部署属性、具体费用或维护资源需求。
本地数值控件只重算容量硬条件，显示改变的是假设，不更新原始来源或确认预留计划；刷新恢复原始需求。容量达标不等于整体胜出，价格、迁移代价和偏好未知。以上不认证世界事实、作者身份或任意模型正文。

structuredContent.semantics: Protocol 1.4 requires expectedEffect on every input: hard, preference-only or hard-and-preference must match the actual requirement/constraint and preference-rule dependency graph, including when predicates. Boolean requirements also require dimension.semanticRole and input.semanticRole: supports pairs capability-support with capability-need; requires-availability pairs resource-need with resource-available. A contradictory relation, missing role or mismatched expected effect is rejected without rewriting. These declarations do not verify the source or free prose. Use typed numeric dimensions (kind=number, unit, numeric or null option values) and requirements for quantitative hard limits. Use kind=boolean and relation=supports for capability needs such as private networking; option values are true/false/null and the local input is a unitless boolean. Unneeded capability is inactive, not a reason to exclude an option that supports it. For an option that REQUIRES a resource (for example needs team maintenance), use relation=requires-availability: the option dimension means it needs the resource, and the input means the user has it. An option needing no maintenance stays eligible even when team availability is unknown or false; an option requiring it fails when availability is false. Do not use supports for a burden; it reverses that predicate. Provider updates do not establish all maintenance responsibilities. Do not invent a currency or billing period for an unknown price; use a text dimension with null until supplied. Deployment simplicity and maintenance simplicity are separate facts; leave an unspecified counterpart null, not a Boolean opposite. Explicitly check which side means capability versus requirement against the original source. This is a declared mapping, not source certification. Every local input must affect a requirement, constraint or rule; unused controls are rejected. A numeric requirement compares that dimension with a numeric local input in exactly the same unit: at-least means option value >= demand; at-most means option value <= limit. Use an ordinary requirement for current demand, not only a conditionally confirmed future demand. Prefer one required-quantity control to explore 80GB versus 300GB; possible future growth is not an already confirmed plan. Capacity eligibility is not preference. Protocol 1.2 and later withhold ALL preference policies until the human explicitly enables local exploration; even origin=given is only a model-declared label and cannot authorize a recommendation. Unknown comparison cells still block preference. Local demand/limit controls do not fill unknown option facts. Do not promise that entering a budget reveals an unknown price. The render receipt returns decisionFacts evaluated under original conditions. Its inputEffects lists hard requirements, constraints and preference rules affected by every input. A preference-only input cannot change hard eligibility; do not claim that a reserve-growth toggle enforces future capacity unless linked to a capacity requirement. Prefer a single capacity input to inspect 80 versus 300GB. Unknown critical comparison dimensions do not justify a winner. Unless the user explicitly requests a hypothetical policy, leave recommendation rules empty when facts cannot establish a choice. Check prose against its status and recommendedOptionIds; insufficient conditions must not be described as a winner. Declared origins are not independently verified. Rules use all/any clauses, highest priority wins; equal-priority matches combine recommendations. Missing values are unknown. Constraints exclude options. No scores are inferred. Preserve the supplied option set; seeking more information is an action, not an extra supplier or platform. Only explicitly supplied conditions may have non-null initial values; unspecified priorities, certainty and team capacity start null. A known value cannot be called better than an unknown value. A priority alone cannot resolve an unknown comparison: do not automatically prefer the known supplier. A hard constraint excludes its option when its predicate is true; never use it to express permission, a preference, or information-gathering. Its reason must agree with that exclusion. Capacity facts can exclude options, but do not establish costs or a preference. Mark proposed preference rules origin=model-judgment unless the user explicitly supplied that policy.
